title: Cosmic Crystal Portal
description: A surreal cosmic landscape features a large glowing purple crystal ball on a tripod stand, displaying an inner scene of an astronaut walking through a lavender field with floating masks and planets. The black space background contains a large red ringed planet, multiple floating eyes, smaller planets, and constellations, while the foreground shows a black-and-white line drawing of an astronaut walking through lavender fields that transition into the colored cosmic scene.
prompt: Surreal cosmic landscape with a large glowing purple crystal ball on a tripod in the center, revealing an inner world of an astronaut walking through a lavender field with floating theatrical masks and tiny planets. Black space background filled with a large red ringed planet, multiple stylized floating eyes with blue irises, smaller orange planets, white line constellations, and geometric shapes. Foreground shows black and white ink drawing of another astronaut walking through detailed lavender fields that blend into the colorful cosmic scene.
